counting_rules: All complete saved TEIs under the three named input roots; one capture per document, no candidate filtering.
Count each citation paragraph at most once for the exact issue317 detector. Baseline is literal TEI text through the current no-source parser.
Source recovery requires matching TEI/prepared-PDF byte receipts. All original inputs remain read-only.
Signature counts are not repair precision/recall or proof that every paragraph/target is correct.
Each detector-positive paragraph is queried by intext; an excerpt is checked only when at least one actual materialized reference target resolves.
No full-library population, live transport or fresh-extraction claim. New source fixtures were selected after the broader replay exposed two remaining failures.
